name: io.github.DiffCI/diffci
title: DiffCI
description: Verification for AI coding agents: runs the tests and checks a change affects, with a receipt.

tools.name: diffci_validation_plan
tools.description: Plan change-aware CI validation, affected-test selection, test impact analysis, or GitHub Actions workflow checks. Returns a safe local DiffCI command without accessing the checkout or executing it.

repo.description: Optional local repository path to pass as a single --repo argument.

platform.description: Shell used only to render the display command. Defaults to posix.

tools.name: diffci_interpret_report
tools.description: Validate and summarize a DiffCI observation report, including selective or full mode, affected-test counts, fallbacks, non-interference evidence, and the conservative next action.

tools.name: diffci_verify_workflow_text
tools.description: Perform a stateless preliminary safety check of GitHub Actions YAML: dedicated observer job, continue-on-error, dependency isolation, read-only permissions, and immutable DiffCI references.

workflow.description: One GitHub Actions workflow YAML document.
